description: Golden eval for news-scout cycle. Validates news fetching, sentiment + impact scoring, regime multipliers, PMI detection, commodity chains, Hao 5 dedup, signal posting schemas, session log format, and error boundary behavior.

cases.name: Breaking watchlist news — post urgent_news signal
cases.description: High-impact article about a watchlist ticker must produce an urgent_news signal with all required finding_data fields.

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: NEUTRAL
VND Carry Spread: +1.50%

fetched_articles.title: SBV cắt giảm lãi suất tái cấp vốn 0.5%
fetched_articles.content: Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam hôm nay tuyên bố cắt giảm lãi suất tái cấp vốn xuống còn 4.0%, hiệu lực từ ngày 10/05.

regime_multiplier_applied.note: NEUTRAL = no change to impact score

payload.title: SBV cắt giảm lãi suất tái cấp vốn 0.5%

finding_data.headline: SBV cắt giảm lãi suất tái cấp vốn 0.5%

assertions: regime must be NEUTRAL parsed from macro_snapshot
search_similar_context must be called for articles with impactScore >= 6
Hao 5 check must be called before posting: get_agent_signals(hours=2, status='in_processing')
urgent_news finding_data must contain: headline, source, severity, regime, regime_adjusted_score
severity must be one of: low | medium | high | critical
confidence (if included) as decimal 0–1
ttl_minutes = 120, chain_depth = 0

cases.name: chain_catalyst — macro crisis triggers all-agent broadcast
cases.description: High-impact macro news must produce a chain_catalyst signal to 'all' with required finding_data fields.

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: TIGHTENING
VND Carry Spread: +0.80%

fetched_articles.title: US Federal Reserve raises rates 50bps — emerging market selloff begins
fetched_articles.content: Federal Reserve surprised markets with a 50bps emergency hike. Asian markets are experiencing sharp outflows.

finding_data.headline: US Federal Reserve raises rates 50bps — emerging market selloff begins

expected_outputs.note_on_regime_in_finding_data: regime field NOT included in chain_catalyst finding_data (schema is strict, extra fields stripped). Regime included in payload.detail instead.

assertions: chain_catalyst must be posted to_agent='all'
finding_data must NOT include 'regime' key (ChainCatalystFindingDataSchema strips extra fields)
regime context must be in payload.detail as string: 'regime=TIGHTENING regime_adj_score=N'
required finding_data fields: event_type, direction, confidence, affected_stocks, affected_sectors, headline, source
TIGHTENING + bearish regime multiplier = 1.3 applied to impact_score
confidence must be decimal 0–1

cases.name: PMI < 50 two consecutive months — GDP warning signal
cases.description: When Vietnam Manufacturing PMI < 50 for two consecutive months, a bearish chain_catalyst with gdp_warning_signal=true must be posted.

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: NEUTRAL
VND Carry Spread: +1.20%

fetched_articles.title: Vietnam Manufacturing PMI 48.2 in April — third month of contraction
fetched_articles.content: S&P Global: Vietnam Manufacturing PMI 48.2 (April), down from 48.9 (March). New orders declining.

signals_posted.payload_note: PMI < 50 hai tháng liên tiếp — cảnh báo GDP quý tới (lead: 6-8 tuần)

assertions: PMI value must be extracted from article text (S&P Global source)
PMI < 50 AND previous month PMI < 50 triggers gdp_warning_signal=true
chain_catalyst must be posted with event_type=macro, direction=bearish
finding_data must include gdp_warning_signal=true
note must reference '6-8 tuần' lead time
current PMI value must be stored in session log for next cycle
PMI > 52 after prior < 50 triggers bullish chain_catalyst with gdp_recovery_signal=true

cases.name: Brent crude > 5% — CPI pressure chain
cases.description: Brent crude up > 5% vs prior month must trigger cpi_pressure_risk=true in chain_catalyst signal.

fetched_articles.title: Brent crude surges 6.2% after OPEC surprise cut
fetched_articles.content: Brent crude hit $95.40/barrel, up 6.2% from April average of $89.80.

expected_outputs.chain_catalyst_note: Dầu tăng mạnh → áp lực CPI → SBV có thể thắt chặt

assertions: Brent crude change > 5% vs prior month triggers cpi_pressure_risk flag
chain_catalyst note must include 'Dầu tăng mạnh → áp lực CPI → SBV có thể thắt chặt'
cpi_pressure_risk=true must be in finding_data or signal payload
Brent < 5% must NOT trigger this chain

cases.name: Gold spike > 3% — VND asset flight signal for banking + BVH
cases.description: Gold spike > 3% in the week must produce urgent_news targeting banking and BVH watchlist stocks.

fetched_articles.title: Gold hits $3,250/oz — up 3.8% this week on safe-haven demand

expected_outputs.signal_note: Vàng tăng — tín hiệu dân cư tìm nơi trú ẩn, thoát VND asset

assertions: Gold > 3% weekly triggers urgent_news for banking tickers + BVH
signal note must include 'Vàng tăng — tín hiệu dân cư tìm nơi trú ẩn, thoát VND asset'
Gold < 3% must NOT trigger this signal

cases.name: Hao 5 dedup — same ticker + signal type in last 2h skips posting
cases.description: When an identical ticker + signal_type exists in the agent bus with status='in_processing' within 2 hours, the new signal must be skipped.

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: NEUTRAL
VND Carry Spread: +1.00%

fetched_articles.title: VNM tăng trưởng doanh thu Q1 vượt kỳ vọng

assertions: Hao 5 check must call get_agent_signals(hours=2, status='in_processing') before every signal post
Same ticker + signal_type in last 2h = SKIP
Log must contain 'Hào 5 check: {ticker}/{type} → skip'
post_agent_signal must NOT be called when skipping
Skip is NOT an error — no BUG channel message

cases.name: EASING regime + bullish — score multiplier 1.2
cases.description: Under EASING regime, bullish news impact score must be multiplied by 1.2 before posting.
assertions: EASING + bullish = multiplier 1.2
EASING + bearish = multiplier 0.8
TIGHTENING + bearish = multiplier 1.3
TIGHTENING + bullish = multiplier 0.7
NEUTRAL = multiplier 1.0 (no change)
regime_adjusted_score must be stored in finding_data

cases.name: HOT_MONEY_INFLOW with carry spread > 3% — hot_money_risk flag
cases.description: When CARRY_REGIME=HOT_MONEY_INFLOW and carry spread > 3%, hot_money_risk=true must be set on FII-related news signals.

article.title: Foreign investors net buy VN stocks 4th consecutive session

assertions: carry_spread > 3% + HOT_MONEY_INFLOW triggers hot_money_risk=true
hot_money_risk must be set in finding_data
carry_spread = 2.9% must NOT trigger (boundary strictly > 3%)

cases.name: Error boundary — fetch_and_analyze fails after 1 retry
cases.description: Tool failure at Step 1 after 1 retry must trigger BUG channel message and immediate exit. No incident files created.

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: NEUTRAL
VND Carry Spread: +1.00%

expected_outputs.bug_message_pattern: [news-scout] Step 1 failed: VPS proxy timeout: connection refused 10.0.0.5:8765
expected_outputs.session_log_entry_pattern: Cycle HH:MM — BLOCKED at step 1: VPS proxy timeout

assertions: bug message must start with [news-scout]
bug message must be single line
session log must contain 'BLOCKED at step N: {error}'
NO standalone blocker/incident/recovery files created
NO 'Recommended Action' or 'Next Steps' sections written
NO docker-compose, curl, or infrastructure commands in any output
cycle must exit — do NOT investigate or diagnose infrastructure

cases.name: Bootstrap failure — market_context missing triggers BUG + STOP
cases.description: If bootstrap returns without market_context, agent must send BUG and stop.
assertions: missing market_context is a hard stop — no partial cycle execution
BUG channel message must be sent
agent must NOT proceed to Step 1 without market_context

cases.name: WORK channel message format — every cycle
cases.description: WORK channel message must follow exact format with HH:MM UTC, signals analyzed, fired/suppressed counts.

work_channel_message_schema.format_example:
[News Scout] 09:04 UTC — 12 signals analyzed
  Fired: 3 (catalysts) | Suppressed: 2 | Next: 10:00

assertions: message must start with [News Scout]
must include HH:MM UTC
must include signals analyzed count
must include 'Fired: X (catalysts)'
must include 'Suppressed: Y'
must include 'Next: TIME'

cases.name: Session log format — required fields
cases.description: Session log entry must contain all required fields in the standard cycle heading format.
assertions: notebook file path: docs/agent-memory/notebooks/news-scout.md
heading must be '### Cycle (HH:MM–HH:MM)'
all 5 required fields must be present
log_agent_work must also be called with action='news-scout-cycle'
log_agent_work context must include: items, impacts, signals_fired, regime

cases.name: Batch 2 sentiment log — daily 05:00 UTC ledger append
cases.description: At 05:00 UTC, per-ticker sentiment must be appended to docs/analysis-briefs/{TICKER}.md. New tickers get file created first.
assertions: Run at 05:00 UTC daily only
If file does not exist: create with all 4 section headings first
Append under '## [News Scout] Headlines & Sentiment' section
Format: YYYY-MM-DD | {description} | YoY: {comparison}
Skip when |sentiment_score| < 0.1 AND not neutral (i.e., only append when |score| >= 0.1 OR documenting neutral absence)
FPT sentiment 0.05 — below 0.1 threshold — skip
Skip weekends and Vietnamese public holidays

cases.name: signal_type schema validation — missing severity field rejected
cases.description: A post_agent_signal call with missing 'severity' in urgent_news finding_data must fail validation.
assertions: urgent_news finding_data requires: headline, source, severity
missing severity must reject with validation error
chain_catalyst finding_data requires: event_type, direction, confidence, affected_stocks, affected_sectors, headline, source
invalid severity value (e.g. 'HIGH' uppercase) must also reject

chain_catalyst_finding_data.note: ChainCatalystFindingDataSchema uses no .passthrough(). Extra fields silently stripped. Do NOT include 'regime' key here — use payload.detail instead.

pmi_detection_rules.source: S&P Global — published 2nd–3rd of each month

commodity_chain_triggers.brent_crude_5pct: Dầu tăng mạnh → áp lực CPI → SBV có thể thắt chặt, sets cpi_pressure_risk=true
commodity_chain_triggers.gold_3pct_weekly: Vàng tăng — tín hiệu dân cư tìm nơi trú ẩn, thoát VND asset, targets banking + BVH

forbidden_behaviors: Logging a suppressed signal as POSTED (phantom success)
Posting urgent_news signal without checking Hao 5 dedup first
Including 'regime' key directly in chain_catalyst finding_data (schema strips it)
Posting finding_data without required fields (headline, source, severity for urgent_news)
Creating standalone incident/blocker files on tool failure
Adding 'Recommended Action' or 'Next Steps' with ops commands on error
Continuing cycle when market_context is missing from bootstrap
Writing to market channel without news content (work-only cycles)
Appending to analysis-briefs without creating the file first if it doesn't exist
Claiming MCP is unavailable without attempting the tool call
